PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.

5. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.

6. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.

7. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

8. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

9. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.

10. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Software and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bookkeeping 12 5.2 Income and Budgeting 9 5.3 Marketing goods and Services 8 5.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Income and Budgeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing goods and Services 8 5.4 Distribution of Goods and Services 7 Total Nu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
